outline:
本課程介紹科技論文寫作與報告，課程內容包括科技論文寫作元素介紹(摘要、介紹、方法、結果、討論、結論)與撰寫方式，文獻搜尋與整理，報告與發表注意事項，以利環境所碩博士生應用於未來論文撰寫與成果發表。
This class focuses on the Introduction of major elements in technical writing, including abstract, introduction, research methods, results, discussion, and conclusion. Writing grammar, style, and methods to perform literature search and review are also introduced. The main aim of this course is to enhance the ability of graduate students in future thesis writing and research publication.
schedule:
Week 1 (4/12): How to publish papers in world-class journals
	General Introduction
	How to properly cite a paper? Using reference software such as Mendeley or Endnote.
	Homework #1 (1): Please insert at least 10 references (should be more than 10) in your introduction for “your” journal. (2): Outline your “Methods and material” into 3 subsections
Week 2 (4/19): Chap 6: How did you study the problem?
	Tense and examples
	Avoid starting sentences with the words” it” and “there”
	Presentations: Full introduction with references.
	Homework #2: Finish your first subsection (should be > 100 words)
Week 3 (4/26): Chap 7: How did you proceed?
	Steps and examples
	Misplaced & Dangling Modifier.
	Presentations: first subsection.
	Homework #3: Finish your second subsection (should be > 100 words)
Week 4 (5/3): Chap 8: What did you observe?
	Reduce pronoun
	Examples
	Presentation: second subsection.
	Homework #4: Finish your third subsection (should be > 100 words)
Week 5 (5/10): Chap 9 How can you describe quantities?
	Redundancy
	Which, that and pronoun
	Examples
	Presentation: third subsection.
